info.title: IP-Max API
info.description: Prepaid GeoIP and IP intelligence lookups. Each product has its own CNY balance; amounts are expressed in micro-CNY (1 CNY = 1,000,000) and are exact multiples of 0.5.

200.description: Availability, unit prices and purchase contact.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix time in seconds when the current window resets.

get.summary: Account balances and the latest 100 ledger entries

post.description: Charges the current catalog unit price for each successful response. Reuse the same Idempotency-Key when retrying the same product and IP: completed retries return the original result and receipt without another charge. Validation errors, missing records, insufficient balance and failed requests are never charged.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 16–120 printable ASCII characters identifying this billable request. A UUID is a good choice.

X-Billing-Replayed.description: true when this is a stored result returned for a repeated idempotency key.

402.description: Insufficient product balance; nothing was charged.

404.description: The address is not in the database; nothing was charged.

409.description: The price changed during processing, or the Idempotency-Key was already used for a different query; nothing was charged.

429.description: Rate limited; see Retry-After. Nothing was charged.

post.summary: Threat and network intelligence, without geography

Validation errors, missing records, insufficient balance and failed requests are never charged.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 16–120 printable ASCII characters identifying this billable request. A UUID is a good choice.

X-Billing-Replayed.description: true when this is a stored result returned for a repeated idempotency key.

402.description: Insufficient product balance; nothing was charged.

404.description: The address is not in the database; nothing was charged.

409.description: The price changed during processing, or the Idempotency-Key was already used for a different query; nothing was charged.

429.description: Rate limited; see Retry-After. Nothing was charged.

apiKey.description: Send the API key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

AbuseReports.description: Community abuse-report aggregates over the last 30 days.

keyPrefix.description: Display prefix of the API key used for this request.

Account.description: The authenticated account with per-product balances and its latest 100 ledger entries.

request_id.description: Quote this id when contacting support.

retryable.description: Whether the same request may succeed later.

exchanges_total.description: Total exchanges known for this ASN; present when the exchange list was truncated.

AsnConnectivity.description: Interconnection inventory of the origin ASN. Capacity ranges are estimates.

available.description: Whether paid queries are accepted right now.

Catalog.description: Current product prices, availability and the purchase contact.

DnsRecords.description: Passive DNS evidence for the address.

ErrorCode.description: Opaque numeric error id. Known values: 1000 invalid request, 1001 invalid payload, 1002 invalid IP, 1003 IP not found, 1004 route not found, 1010 invalid or revoked API key, 1011 rate limit exceeded, 1400 service unavailable, 1401 internal error, 1500 insufficient product balance, 1501 idempotency key conflict. New values may be added; treat unknown values as opaque.

ErrorResponse.description: Error envelope shared by every endpoint.

netmask.description: Netmask of the matched database record.

prefix_length.description: Prefix length of the matched database record.

GeoIpData.description: Geography, country enrichment and basic ASN identity for one IP address.

adcode.description: Administrative division code for mainland China, otherwise empty.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, or null when unknown.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, or null when unknown.

radius.description: Accuracy radius in kilometres, or null when unknown.

intelligence.description: Best-effort live observations gathered at query time. An empty observation is not a clean-risk verdict.

IntelligenceData.description: Threat and network intelligence for one IP address. Geography is intentionally absent; use the GeoIP product for it.

amountMicros.description: Movement amount in micro-CNY. Credits and charges are positive; adjustments may be signed.

balanceMicros.description: Wallet balance after this entry, in micro-CNY.

revoked_tags.description: Database network tags contradicted by live evidence for this address.

segment_probe.description: Observation of the /24 gateway (.1) for IPv4 targets; null when the target is the gateway itself or nothing was observed.

LiveIntelligence.description: Best-effort live observations gathered at query time. Reserved addresses always carry empty observations.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to query.

NetworkClassification.description: A single usage class for the address, plus contradictory evidence kept for audit.

unitMicros.description: Price per successful query in micro-CNY (1 CNY = 1,000,000), always an exact multiple of 0.5.

Price.description: Unit price of one successful query.

PtrIntelligence.description: Reverse-DNS hostname with optional operator and metro location parsed from it.

ResourceTransfer.description: One RIR resource transfer covering the address or its origin ASN.

RpkiInfo.description: RPKI route origin validation of the covering route.

lastUpdated.description: Unix time in milliseconds of the last validator sync.
Unix time in milliseconds of the last validator sync.

ThreatInfo.description: Threat signals. A null flag means no evidence either way.
